title: Digital Signal Processing I
description: Discrete-time signals and systems. Signal properties and basic signal transformations. System properties. Linear time-invariant systems and convolution. Discrete-time Fourier series. The Fourier transform and spectral analysis. The z transform and its use in system analysis. The relationship between the Fourier and z transforms. Sampling. Analysis and design of discrete-time systems. Solving difference equations with the z transform.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 310, ELEC 310.
